field.name: cnvID
field.comment: The ID of the conversation holding the messages, which belongs to this block and is deleted with it

field.name: enablePosting
field.comment: true: the visitors can add messages; false or NULL: the conversation is read-only

field.name: paginate
field.comment: true: the messages are split in pages of itemsPerPage messages; false: they are all displayed

field.name: itemsPerPage
field.comment: How many messages a page displays (used if paginate is true)

field.name: displayMode
field.comment: threaded: the replies are nested under the message they answer to; flat: every message is displayed at the same level

field.name: orderBy
field.comment: date_asc: the messages are displayed oldest first; date_desc: most recent first; rating: highest rated first

field.name: enableOrdering
field.comment: true: the visitors can change the order of the messages; false: they are stuck with orderBy

field.name: enableCommentRating
field.comment: true: the visitors can rate the messages; false: they can't

field.name: enableTopCommentReviews
field.comment: true: the highest and the lowest rated messages are displayed before the other ones; false: they are not singled out

field.name: displaySocialLinks
field.comment: true: every message offers the links that share it on social networks; false: they are left out

field.name: reviewAggregateAttributeKey
field.comment: The ID of the rating attribute of the page that the ratings of the messages are aggregated into

field.name: displayPostingForm
field.comment: top: the form that adds a message is displayed above the messages; bottom: below them

field.name: addMessageLabel
field.comment: The text of the button that adds a message (empty: the default one)

field.name: dateFormat
field.comment: default: the date of a message is displayed with the format of the site; elapsed: as the time since it was posted; custom: with customDateFormat

field.name: customDateFormat
field.comment: A format accepted by the date() PHP function (used if dateFormat is custom)
